description: This is a Bash shell script that automates the building of Docker images for various services by defining functions to handle proxy settings, image building, and script argument parsing, and then executing the build process.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: build_docker_image
methods.description: Builds a Docker image for a specified service using provided arguments.

methods.name: build_all_docker_images
methods.description: Iterates over all specified services and builds their Docker images.

methods.name: set_proxies
methods.description: Configures proxy environment variables based on input.

methods.name: evaluate_script_arguments
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure script execution.
